_standing: The Track 1 -> Track 2 hand-off. Written 2026-09-06 from the research record (H003-H009, methodology 070-074) and public literature. Coordinate-free by rule: it names the gene, the protein and the variant classes, never a position. Revised, never edited: bump `version` and append to `history`.

case._mondo_note: Open Targets resolves MVA1 to MONDO_0009759 (verified live 2026-09-06 through disease_search on the disease name); the earlier MONDO:0009551 was wrong

gene.protein: BubR1 (mitotic checkpoint serine/threonine-protein kinase BUB1 beta)

alleles.label: stop
alleles.reading: null allele: truncates BubR1 upstream of the C-terminal kinase domain

alleles.label: missense
alleles.reading: presumed hypomorph: a partly working copy inside the C-terminal kinase domain (CDD cd14029)

mechanism.class: loss-of-function, hypomorphic (compound heterozygote: one null allele + one partly functional allele)
mechanism.status: inferred from Track 1; the trans configuration is what the oracle tests (H009, testing)
mechanism.pathway: spindle assembly checkpoint (SAC) - mitotic checkpoint complex (MCC) formation and APC/C-CDC20 inhibition
mechanism.immediate_effect: reduced BubR1 abundance and checkpoint signalling; weakened kinetochore-microtubule attachment error correction
downstream: mosaic aneuploidy in dividing tissues (variegated: different chromosomes in different cells)
aneuploidy-associated proteotoxic and metabolic stress in surviving cells
cancer predisposition: rhabdomyosarcoma, Wilms tumour, leukaemia (MVA1 spectrum)
growth restriction (short stature, failure to thrive, IUGR), nephrocalcinosis
mechanism.complete_loss: embryonic lethal in mouse and human - full inhibition of BubR1 is not a therapeutic direction

literature.role: Hanks 2004: biallelic BUB1B mutations cause MVA with cancer predisposition; truncating + missense genotypes
Suijkerbuijk 2010: MVA patient cells have strongly reduced BUBR1 and a weakened SAC; missense alleles act as hypomorphs
BubR1 insufficiency, aneuploidy and premature ageing in the mouse hypomorph

repurposing_directions.name: SAC reinforcement / chromosomal-instability reduction
repurposing_directions.rationale: compensate for reduced BubR1 signalling; agents that prolong mitotic checkpoint arrest or stabilise kinetochore-microtubule attachments

repurposing_directions.name: aneuploidy-selective stress exploitation
repurposing_directions.rationale: aneuploid cells carry proteotoxic and energy stress; published aneuploidy-selective killing (AICAR-class energy stress, chloroquine-class autophagy stress, HSP90/HSF1 axis)

repurposing_directions.name: proteostasis / BubR1 stabilisation for a hypomorph
repurposing_directions.rationale: a partly working protein can be stabilised or its turnover slowed; explore APC/C, deacetylase and chaperone routes; note BubR1 acetylation regulates its stability

repurposing_directions.name: cancer prevention in the MVA1 tumour context
repurposing_directions.rationale: the child's presenting tumour is rhabdomyosarcoma; approved agents with a chemoprevention or surveillance rationale in aneuploidy-driven tumours

constraints.eligibility: market-approved drugs only (challenge rules, Track 2 definition); ChEMBL max_phase 4 or an FDA label is the evidence of approval
